# Circa AI Group

> AI consulting and automation for small service businesses. Circa AI Group designs and builds AI-powered operating systems — client intake, follow-up, document handling, deadline tracking, and executive support — for accounting firms, property tax consultants, insurance agencies, law firms, and professional services firms in the US, Canada, and UK. Founded by Debbie Marie, who spent 20 years running executive operations for C-suite offices before bringing that discipline to AI automation.

Key facts:
- The engagement model is called The Operational Freedom Method™: five stages (Discover, Diagnose, Design, Deploy, Scale) across three system layers (Growth Systems, Execution Systems, Operating Systems).
- Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute discovery call — a conversation to ask questions, get clarity on where AI could fit the business, and assess mutual fit.
- Guarantee: an engagement is not complete until the client can run the system without the consultant; if it takes longer, work continues at no additional cost.
- Documented client results include a 60% admin-time reduction through tax season for a solo CPA and 26 hours reclaimed per peak week for a property tax consultancy, with $37,500 in projected recaptured revenue.
- The Chief of Staff Operating System is a private executive support system (communications, planning, travel, knowledge, workflow) built for CEOs; companion training equips a client's EA or VA to run it.
- No technical background is required to operate anything Circa builds.
